name: asdair-bot
description: BUILD-015 AsdAIr control surface: the ShopperBot message catalogue, the asd: callback wire format, the inbound intent router, the question render contract (what a card displayed, so a tapped index cannot be misresolved after a re-render) and the outbound sender. Renders, routes and resolves only — never plans, never drives a browser, never checks out and never pays, and opens no database connection of its own (the store is injected). Zero dependencies; never polls Telegram (services/asdair/intake/ is the only consumer of that stream).
